name: Territory Image Extension
description: Extends a source image with Firefly Generative Expand so it fills each target layout canvas, from the final image placement per layout. Targets share one master generation where possible; the original pixels are kept unchanged.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: The original image, as placed by the upstream layout / subject placement step

inputs.name: layout
inputs.description: Targets: { targets: [{ id, canvas: { width, height }, placement: { x, y, width, height } }] } — canvas pixels; placement = where the whole source lies on the canvas

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: Optional Firefly prompt for the generated areas (max 1024 characters)

outputs.name: extendedImages
outputs.description: One PNG per target at its canvas size, named <target id>.png (targets that need review or failed have no image)

outputs.name: extensionMetadata
outputs.description: Per target: status (extended | not_required | needs_review | failed), missing sides, extension ratio, original region, master id, Firefly job id, warnings; plus the master generations

parameters.name: batchMode
parameters.description: shared: as few master generations as possible (consistent content across layouts); independent: one generation per target

parameters.name: maxExtensionRatio
parameters.description: Automatic limit: Firefly may generate at most this share of the source per axis; larger targets need review

parameters.name: allowLarge
parameters.description: Generate targets over the extension / resolution limit anyway (after a human decision)

parameters.name: coverageTolerancePx
parameters.description: Gaps up to this many canvas pixels per side are filled from the original edge instead of Firefly

commonPatterns: Run after subject placement, once each layout's final image placement is known, to fill the uncovered canvas areas
Run before text colour detection, so colours are judged on the extended image
bestPractices: Send all layouts of one image in one job: they then share one Firefly master generation and match each other
Keep placements at or below the source resolution; a placement that upscales the source can exceed the resolution limit
Route targets with status needs_review to a human; rerun with allowLarge only after approval
